what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a max speed static contributes its granted effect (a P/T boost or keywords) to its source while its controller's speed is 4.
near_miss: A continuous record where the max speed static is present but contributes nothing because the controller's speed is below 4.
record_fields: sidecar script text of the acting static

what_to_detect: A continuous record written when a player's speed reaches 4, in which a max speed static begins contributing.
near_miss: A continuous record of a max speed static with its controller's speed still below 4.
